roadmap.dc.pWait: waits for approval — not given to agents

roadmap.dc.pCandTitle: These notes seem to share one cause: {list}. A pattern is one rule instead of them. An agent writes the text from a card, you approve it
roadmap.dc.pCand: looks like a pattern: {id} and {n} more
roadmap.dc.pMakeTitle: Add an Inbox card «{title}»: an agent reads the notes and writes the pattern. Agents get it only after «approve»
roadmap.dc.pNoTitle: Different causes: {id} gets pattern: {no} in its header, a pattern around {id} is no longer suggested. Undo — remove the line in the file
roadmap.dc.pWarn: Pattern approvals cannot be read: {error}. Patterns are not given to agents, their notes are given as before
roadmap.wrongBoxTitle: An agent marked these records “wrong” and said why. Agents don’t get them until you decide: “correct” or “cancel”
roadmap.wave.label: Wave:
roadmap.wave.freeTitle: Run independent cards: queued cards whose dependencies are all done
roadmap.wave.allTitle: Run all queued cards of the phase: cards with unfinished dependencies wait and start on their own
roadmap.wave.selTitle: Run selected cards. Select: Ctrl+click, Shift+click, drag a frame; clear with Esc
roadmap.wave.oneTitle: Run with one agent: one prompt and one tab for up to 5 queued cards in order — the selected ones, or the phase's cards if nothing is selected. A card the agent didn't take returns to the queue when the tab closes
roadmap.report.openTitle: Phase report: what was done and the proof for each card, the phase notes — {file}
roadmap.report.sumTitle: The agent adds a plain-words conclusion and candidates for shared notes to the report. You make them shared with the “for all projects” checkbox on the notes screen
roadmap.report.sumOpened: The agent is writing the summary in a tab: the section will appear at the end of the report
roadmap.report.sumDone: Summary written — the section is at the end of the report
roadmap.report.sumLost: Summary not written: the tab was closed
roadmap.wave.name: Wave {letter}
roadmap.wave.stopTitle: Stop the wave: nothing new starts, tabs of the cards the wave opened close. Cards started manually stay.
roadmap.wave.why.gone: card is not on the board
roadmap.wave.resumeTitle: Resume the wave: cards that are done, cancelled or changed after the stop are skipped; cards already started are not started again
roadmap.showTitle: The card agent runs in the background: show its tab in the top strip
roadmap.untoldTitle: Message not delivered: {why}. Sent as a Windows notification
roadmap.runLiveBg: The card is already running in the background: “Show” opens its tab
roadmap.bg.title: The card agent starts in a hidden tab: it is not in the strip, the card gets a “Show” button. When the card is “done”, the tab closes by itself, the screen stays in .kermach/runs/<card>-<time>.log
roadmap.bgl.title: Agents in hidden tabs of the project. How many — see the “in background: N” button next to “+” above the tabs
roadmap.bgl.stopTitle: Stop the agent and close its tab without asking — like kermach tab close --force
roadmap.lim.title: How many project cards run at once, both from a wave and from the Run button. Over the limit, wave cards wait for a slot
roadmap.asked.cap: Search by meaning: asked {n}, not found {m}
roadmap.asked.title: Agents searched the code with kermach code meaning. Search by meaning is not connected yet, so they searched by words. “Not found” means the answer was empty or weak: the query words are not in the code, or the best place matched half of the words or fewer. If “not found” grows, it is time to return to search by meaning. Queries are in {file}
stop.detail:
Agents: {parts}. Their work will be interrupted.
Tabs will come back on the next start, and so will Claude conversations.
stop.detailNoDaemon:
The terminal daemon is not responding: what the agents are doing is unknown. Their work will be interrupted.
The daemon will be shut down together with all tabs.
stop.unknown: unknown: the daemon is not responding
term.bypassHuman: Only a person can turn on “no permission prompts” mode: the “+” menu item or the project setting
term.bypassOff: “No permission prompts” mode is disabled by Claude settings: {file} (permissions.disableBypassPermissionsMode)
term.daemonFail: The terminal daemon did not start: {err}
term.daemonLost: connection to the terminal daemon lost — restart the window
term.followCore: Only plugins that ship with the program can follow the “no permission prompts” setting
term.newConversation: Previous conversation not found, a new one was started
term.noConversationId: Tab “{name}” has no conversation ID — it can’t be restarted.
term.notStarted: {title} is not running — reopen the window
term.noPrompt: {title} doesn't take a first message at launch: type the task in the tab after it starts.
term.stopSlow: the terminal did not stop within 5 seconds
layout.title: Layout
layout.name: Preset name
layout.slotNone: All tabs are already shown. Open a new one with “+”.
layout.full: There are already 20 presets. Delete one you do not need and save again.
history.sideTitle: Past Claude and Codex conversations: search and resume
history.title: Conversation history
history.scopeWaitingTitle: Conversations from all projects that are waiting for you
history.whyOptions: The agent offered options to choose from
history.whyPlan: The agent is waiting for plan approval
history.whyPermission: The tab is waiting for an answer
history.whyQuestion: The agent ended with a question
history.badgeTitle: {n} conversation is waiting for your reply
{n} conversations are waiting for your reply
{n} conversations are waiting for your reply
history.snoozeWarn: Until this date the conversation is not shown in “Waiting for me”. A new message in it brings it back earlier.
history.indexing: Indexing {n} of {total} logs — results will grow
history.liveTabNoName: Running in a tab of this window
history.liveOutsideHint: Running in another window (pid {pid}) — close it to resume here
history.liveOutsideHintNoPid: Running in another window — close it to resume here
history.otherProject: This conversation belongs to another folder — open it from that project or copy the command
history.hitMeta: Match in title, folder or ID
history.trashLive: A running conversation can’t be deleted
history.trashWarn: The log and its folder go to the Recycle Bin. You won’t be able to resume it here or in {agent}. Restore it from the Windows Recycle Bin.
dialogs.codexHookNotYet: Codex hook not checked yet: it is checked when the first Codex tab opens
dialogs.codexHookOff: Codex hook is not working (version {v}): after /clear the tab will continue the previous conversation
dialogs.codexHookOk: Codex conversation number: from the hook — working
term.codexHookOff: Codex hook is not working (version {v}): after /clear the tab will continue the previous conversation
term.codexHookNone: the daemon was started without the Codex hook
term.codexHookNoProgram: Codex not found or started through its own .cmd wrapper — the hook is not passed
tasks.name: Tasks
tasks.title: Kermach — Tasks
tasks.sideTitle: Tasks of all projects: the number is today and overdue in this project
tasks.addPh: New task: “Call the supplier tomorrow at 10 p1 #Site @calls”
tasks.badDeadline: Could not read the deadline «{s}»: one date is needed
tasks.noDateOnce: Do not treat this as a date
tasks.cfgNodateHint: Words like «tomorrow» and a deadline in curly braces in the add line stay in the title
tasks.cfgBadge: Task count on the app icon
tasks.cfgBadgeHint: Blue badge with today's task count on the Kermach taskbar button. Off — the button shows only the «agent is waiting» dot
tasks.sortAll: Use this order for all views
tasks.cfgTitle: What to show in the sidebar
tasks.ckPh: Go to: project, label, filter, task…
tasks.doneSub: Log for the month, all projects. Tasks done more than 30 days ago are kept only here
tasks.exported: Open tasks of «{p}» saved to CSV
tasks.tplSaved: Branch {id} saved as a template (CSV). Insert it with «Insert template» or «Import from CSV»
tasks.kEsc: close the window, cancel the edit
tasks.empty: No tasks. Add the first one in the line above: “Buy flour tomorrow p1”
tasks.searchHint: Type a word in the line above — I will find tasks in all projects
tasks.badDue: Could not read the due date “{s}”
tasks.iconSearch: Find an icon: phone, money, star…
tasks.iconsMax: No more than three icons per task
tasks.missedBody: Kermach was closed. See the list in Today
tasks.filterSub: Query in the field above: today & #Site, p1 | @calls, overdue | (week & !@calls)
tasks.noFilters: No saved filters. Type a query in the field above and save it.
tasks.noLabels: No labels: add @label to a task
dialogs.projectsBaseHint: Empty — home folder. “New project” offers to create its folder here.
dialogs.inboxDirHint: Empty — the {d} folder inside the new projects folder (or the home folder). “Tasks” put tasks without a project here.
dialogs.dirNotAbs: A full path is needed, for example D:\Projects: “{p}” won’t do
dialogs.dirLong: The path is longer than 500 characters
dialogs.dirFile: This is a file, not a folder: {p}
dashboard.title: Kermach — Dashboard
dashboard.none: No pinned projects — pin a project in the “Projects” window
roadmap.fz.accCap: All cards are done — the phase can be accepted
roadmap.fz.accAll: All criteria are checked — only the status “done” is left to set.
roadmap.fz.accNoCrit: No criteria — a person decides what to accept by.
roadmap.fz.accTitle: Same as kermach roadmap accept {id}: phase facts and instructions for the main session
roadmap.fz.accHow: Give the main session the command kermach roadmap accept {id} or this text; the status “done” is set after acceptance.
term.linkHintUrl: {key}+click — open, Shift+{key} — in the regular browser
roadmap.bgl.stuckTitle: The agent went quiet, and the card has no open “## Question”: it looks stuck. Check the tab — “Show”
roadmap.bgl.askTitle: The card is waiting for your answer: open the card and answer in the field
roadmap.untoldHint: The “[Roadmap]” line about this card did not reach the tab it was started from ({why}) and went out as a Windows notification. Open the card and the mark goes away; it also goes away after the next message to that tab
roadmap.ans.ph: Answer text — it is added to the card as the “Human answer” section
roadmap.ans.ok: The answer is saved in the card ({head}). Run the card again — the agent will read it
roadmap.check.head: Roadmap check found errors ({n})
roadmap.check.headWave: Wave not started: roadmap check found errors ({n})
roadmap.check.forceTitle: Start the wave with these errors — the same one you clicked, without the check
roadmap.check.dropTitle: Hide the check line: the errors stay, the wave will check the phase again
roadmap.check.reviewCrit: {id} (review): “How to check” lacks {n} of {all} phase criteria
roadmap.check.dependsGone: {id}: depends on {dep}, but there is no such card
